programme.title: UFC. Manel Kape - Kyoji Horiguchi
programme.desc: Martial Arts based TV programme. UFC stands for the Ultimate Fighting Championship which is an American mixed martial arts (MMA) promotion company based in Las Vegas that is owned by William Morris Endeavour.The purpose of UFC fighting was to establish the most effective martial art in a contest that had no weight classes and minimal rules that were as follows: no biting, hair pulling, groin shots and eye gouging. Legendary fighters well known for their ability to win in UFC fighting are Anderson Silva, Brock Lesnar, Connor McGregor and Ken Shamrock. Women's MMA has seen Ronda Rousey defend her title from 2012 to 2015 before she was defeated by Holly Holm another belt holder in more than one martial art.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Belgrado „Partizan" - Kauno „Žalgiris"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: WNBA. "Atlanta Dream" - "Indiana Fever"
programme.desc: Get the best moments of the Women's National Basketball Association, a professional basketball league in the United States. It currently is composed of twelve teams. The regular season is played from May to September, the All Star game is played midway through the season in July and the WNBA Finals at the end of September until the beginning of October.

programme.title: Bundesliga. "Borussia" - "Eintracht"
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. programme.title: Kakà: tutti i gol in Champions League
programme.desc: La magia col Celtic, la storica doppietta di Old Trafford fino all'ultima perla contro l'Atletico: riviviamo tutti i gol di Kaka' in Champions League con le maglie di Milan e Real Madrid.

programme.title: Speciale Inter: Il Film Del Campionato
programme.desc: Le emozioni, le partite più importanti, le migliori immagini e il filo conduttore di Chivu. Tutto concentrato in questo film del 21° scudetto, quello dell’anima nerazzurra.

programme.title: Calciomercato - L'originale
programme.desc: Curiosità, commenti, notizie e anticipazioni sui possibili movimenti del calciomercato. Condotto dal trio Alessandro Bonan, Gianluca Di Marzio e Fayna.

programme.title: Review Of The Season
programme.desc: L'attenzione è rivolta alla finale tra Paris Saint Germain e Arsenal, giocata alla Puskás Aréna di Budapest. Un'occasione per rivivere momenti salienti, interviste esclusive ai protagonisti e retroscena della massima competizione europea.

programme.title: Calciomercato - L'originale

programme.title: Didier Drogba

programme.title: Premier League, I Gol Della Stagione 01/06/2026
programme.desc: Durante la stagione 2025/26 della Premier sono stati segnati 1.045 gol. Riviviamo le reti più belle e significative.

programme.title: Nantes - Paris Saint-Germain
programme.desc: Edizione n. 88, la 24esima della Ligue 1. Tra le 18 partecipanti le neopromosse: Lorient, Paris FC e Metz. Campione in carica il PSG, con 11 titoli nelle ultime 13 stagioni.

programme.title: La rovesciata di Rooney
programme.desc: Ep5 La rovesciata di Rooney -Il 12 febbraio 2011 Wayne Rooney segna in rovesciata per lo United il gol piu' iconico dei derby di Manchester. Riviviamo le emozioni di un momento che restera' nella storia della Premier.

programme.title: Inter - Lazio 1998
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Story: Inter - Lazio 1998. Finale - Riviviamo la finale di Coppa Uefa della stagione 1997/98. Quarta volta nella storia del trofeo che due squadre italiane si incontrano in finale, ma e' la prima in un gara secca.

programme.title: La magia di Bergkamp
programme.desc: In 30 anni di Premier League ci sono stati tanti gol meravigliosi. Ma solo uno e' poesia in movimento: quello di Dennis Bergkamp al Newcastle.
